answer: Score each answer with a median-of-means rule instead of a plain average. At dawn each epoch the jury is split into five random buckets; each bucket averages its grades and the answer receives the median bucket. Any grader vertex sharing a funding root with another counts once per bucket. A sybil ring rubber-stamping its own answers must capture three of five buckets to move the score, so flooding one panel buys nothing before the payout horizon closes.
